purpose: Complete shared-partial-sum prior, followed by reconstructed time rows and the original folded PSN; separate multi-bank arithmetic sensitivity
scope: Same two K8 students, existing20 full-P captures; no RTL, EDA or new training
single_port_point: 96 shared MAC/add lanes;96 lane RFs each1R1W, with7 address slots per p; one96-element state update per issue
seven_bank_point: Seven independent slot banks, each96 lanes with1R1W;96 shared MAC/add lanes plus576 additional Acc24 add lanes. At FC1 issue, each bank chooses its own p from the same source-column mask and receives the common W vector. Coefficient memory stays8x128-bit. PSN remains96 MAC lanes. Same raw state capacity does not imply same area or frequency.

restoration.latencies: synchronous vector read1; register/bypass add1 with writeback forwarding. The existing FC1 latency2 comprises read plus add. Read and write can coincide on1R1W.
restoration.zero_handling: Absent S reads supply constant zero; all-zero output writes are suppressed and validity updated. An all-zero p skips restoration and emits the precomputed original-tau gate template.
restoration.original_tau: unchanged, including offsets associated with t8/t9 before their Yi rows became zero

optimistic_bound: Grant all restoration operations/reads/writes as perfectly hidden before traditional folded PSN consumption. This is an optimistic bound, not a demonstrated schedule; it covers stronger read/copy overlap, PSN tails, and use of spare FTP adders. Do not call it measured throughput.
pipeline_record_note: Explicit common allocation for operand24, coefficient16, product40 and accumulator48 per lane per stage. This conservative architectural data allocation is not standard-cell area.
port_limitations: Seven independent bank updates require seven address/priority engines, write paths, and672 source add lanes. Giving only folded time rows that parallelism is unfair. Overlapping restore with PSN additionally needs arbitration and bank-to-work-register routing; the zero-overhead restore case is therefore only a bound here. No fabricated equal-area claim.
admission: Compare B primarily against complete S+restoreY+foldedA, then show the explicit port/ALU sensitivity. A bare folded-time-row baseline does not establish the incremental value of direct B consumption.
